title: Quadratic recording-work bound
statement: For every finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet and every natural number $T$, let $F$ be the number of movement-count fields per stored row, with one positive and one negative counter for each head, including the input head. Then $(T+1)(F(3T+4)+2T+7) \le (4F+7)(T+1)^2$.
hypotheses_covered: finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet $M$
replaced: For every source machine and horizon $T$, the complete stored-row ledger $(T+1)(F(3T+4) + 2T + 7)$, where $F$ is the field count, is at most $(4F + 7)(T+1)^2$, so native recording work is polynomial in the source horizon, separately from the formula output size.
